description:
Did people ever ignore the "don't try this at home" warning on MythBusters? Is Adam Savage familiar with "rejection sensitivity, and does he feel that "AI slop" is getting in the way of good search results? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members brianbaker, Gwen-Maker-of-Things and xPir8x, whom we thank for their support!
